purpose: Autonomous Round-1 with GPT-6 Luna pinned by default, deterministic compact evidence/context, grouped Foundation synthesis, Store-first batched page audits, and no Production writes.

foundation_jobs.title: Complete URL/Entity Inventory
foundation_jobs.instructions: Build the most complete SEO-relevant URL/entity inventory possible from live sitemaps/crawlable navigation, WordPress/Woo read-only evidence when safely available, raw GSC exports, and existing repository knowledge. Include canonical content entities plus URL-space representatives/policies for machine-generated spaces. Do not collect customer/order data.

foundation_jobs.title: Map page types, taxonomies and CPTs
foundation_jobs.instructions: Map all current WordPress/Woo page types, product types, taxonomies, archives and custom post types; reconcile them against inventory and identify missing families. Explicitly inventory Product Tags and Blog Tags, their assignments, public archive URL patterns and counts. These two tag systems are planned for controlled decommission; do not remove them in Round 1.

foundation_jobs.title: Map legacy URLs
foundation_jobs.instructions: Map legacy URLs using GSC historical pages, current redirects/canonicals and safe read-only evidence. Preserve entity identity and explicitly record unproven mappings.

foundation_jobs.title: Sitewide Technical SEO Baseline
foundation_jobs.instructions: Execute docs/SITEWIDE-TECHNICAL-AUDIT-SPEC.md read-only: crawl/index controls, sitemaps, redirects/errors, canonical/duplicate URL spaces, facets, JS/AJAX discoverability, internal links, structured data, Woo architecture, images, performance/mobile evidence and crawler access. Create initial systemic findings when evidence supports them. Treat Product Tag and Blog Tag archive spaces as explicit decommission candidates: collect current crawl/index/sitemap/canonical/internal-link behavior and migration risks, but make no Production changes. Reuse the deterministic round1 page evidence and A-010/A-012 reports. Network access is disabled for Codex; do not recrawl. PRIMARY INPUTS: data/normalized/round1-foundation-context.json and round1-evidence-summary.json. Do not full-read registry/URL-INVENTORY.csv, A-011, or A-012; use targeted excerpts only for unresolved material gaps.

foundation_jobs.title: Rank Math ownership + duplicate SEO owner audit
foundation_jobs.instructions: In one compact synthesis, complete A-014 and A-015. Audit available Rank Math capability/ownership evidence and duplicate title/meta/canonical/robots/schema/sitemap/redirect owners. Internal configuration hidden by the isolated runtime must remain BLOCKED_BY_ACCESS; do not request broader Production access. Produce both reports.

foundation_jobs.title: Query map + content architecture + systemic findings
foundation_jobs.instructions: In one compact synthesis, complete A-018, A-019 and A-020 from existing GSC/sitewide evidence. Do not infer Page+Query attribution. Build initial Query/Intent Map and Content Architecture, consolidate FAMILY/SITEWIDE findings, and treat Product Tags and Blog Tags as planned family-level decommission programs rather than per-tag model audits. Use compact/normalized evidence first. Do not full-read registry/URL-INVENTORY.csv or large evidence ledgers. Also create the initial internal-link architecture inputs: identify candidate CORE/MANDATORY links shared by a family, FAMILY-SPECIFIC links, CONTEXTUAL/OPTIONAL links, and bidirectional Product/Category ↔ Academy/Article relationships. Do not finalize or implement these rules in Round 1; prepare them for ChatGPT Second Review. Also inventory the existing product-title naming patterns by Store family and identify inconsistencies, including use/omission of «ماری ورک»/Mariwork, product type/name/color, code formatting and size/volume placement. Produce candidates for a Product Title Naming Standard, but do not finalize or implement title changes in Round 1.
